narration: For {identical_months} months the two lives ran exactly the same. In month {fork_month} you took {real_choice}, and the ghost chose {ghost_choice}. That same month, {first_bar_apart} was the first score to part. The layoff reached both lives in month {layoff_month}, and the ghost held {layoff_net_worth_gap}. By month {end_month} the ghost had {net_worth_gap}. More of the ghost's pay was spoken for before each month began, its Freedom {freedom_gap}.
